verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph documents a REST API for OneDrive files. It covers addressing driveItems by ID or path, single-call PUT uploads up to 250 MB, resumable upload sessions for larger files, search across the hierarchy, and delta change tracking, which works as enumeration and listing. Upload and listing are therefore clearly served by documented endpoints rather than only the desktop client. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of download-content, move, and delete endpoints (move appears only as a user action in the overview, not an API call), a list-children endpoint, and independent hands-on corroboration of the file API.
